details:
1. Play this URL in AVPro mode https://server.owo69.me/stream.m3u8

2. Stream doesn't play, stuck at 0:00

3. Stop the stream by playing a different video or switching mode

4. VRChat stops responding

This will also freeze every other PC user in the instance who also loaded the stream.

Quest does not seem to be affected because it just says video player error.

How I made this stream:
